item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:45 HKT 21/Jul/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the dominance of the subtropical ridge, the weather will be persistently very hot and fine over southern China for the rest of this week to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 21/07 (Thursday)
Wind: South to southeast force 2 to 3.
Weather: Fine. Very hot during the day.
Temp range: 28 - 35 C
R.H. range: 55 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
